bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (URL sharing), springboard/ui/src/detect.rs (link detection), springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/pictures.rs (og:image scrape, app-local)
summary: Apple's framework fetches a URL's title, icon, image and video and draws a rich link view. BifrOSt has no SDK API for URL metadata or a rich link view. It can detect URLs in text and share them through the share sheet, and the News app scrapes og:image for its own pictures, but none of that is exposed to apps as link presentation.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-24, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no SDK call returns a title, icon or image for an arbitrary URL; timeout and subresource options have no counterpart

features.feature: Representative title, icon and image of a URL
features.note: News reads the og:image meta tag for its article pictures; og_image, the RUV recipe rewrite, base64 and the corner rounding are tested headless in pictures::tests. Gap: the logic is app-local, not an SDK API, and there is no title or icon lookup. Built 2026-10-17: SDK metadata parsing (title from og:title or the title element, og:image or twitter:image, icon links, relative addresses resolved against the page) and a fetch state with timeout and cancel in springboard/sdk/src/link_metadata.rs (checked_url, resolve, parse, LinkFetch, LinkError); tests link_metadata::tests. The app still sends the request and reports the reply. Built 2026-10-17: News reads its picture through bifrost_app::link_metadata::parse (apps/news-desktop/src/pictures.rs og_image, which resolves relative addresses); tests pictures::tests.

features.note: Built 2026-10-17: a link row drawn from the Card, with the loaded icon or an initial tile, the title and the site name with a Video mark; tests ui link_card::tests (text decisions). No app places it yet; verify the draw on the host preview and Midget.

gaps: No SDK function sends the request for a URL's metadata: link_metadata::LinkFetch holds the timeout and cancel state and parses the reply, but the app does the HTTP request. No video metadata.
The rich link row is drawn by the shared kit (springboard/ui/src/link_card.rs, from linkmeta::Card); no app shows it yet, and the share sheet has no rich preview.
The share sheet sends URLs as plain items and does not show a rich link preview
